newsitem.title: UK: UK firms capital expenditure unchanged in Q4.
newsitem.headline: UK firms capital expenditure unchanged in Q4.

text.p: UK manufacturers' spending on capital assets, including leased assets, was virtually unchanged on a seasonally adjusted basis in the fourth quarter of 1996 over the third quarter, the Office for National Statistics said on Tuesday.
Revised data showed manufacturers' expenditure totalled 2.879 billion stg in the fourth quarter after 2.884 billion in the third.
But capital expenditure was eight percent lower than in the fourth quarter of 1995.
Preliminary figures, released last month, put manufacturers' capital expenditure up 5.0 percent in the fourth quarter.
The revised estimates of capital expenditure for other production rose by one percent, while services rose by five percent and construction jumped 17 percent over the previous quarter, the ONS said.
Other production fell by six percent, services rose by 10 percent and construction leapt 16 percent over the fourth quarter of 1995.
